narrator.instruct: Fast-paced, energetic, punchy explainer narrator. Brisk delivery with no long pauses.

agent.instruct: Polite but tired airport gate agent speaking over a PA microphone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You booked seat fourteen C. Tonight, two people are holding that seat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Across town, a guy on the same flight hits snooze again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You race to the airport, check in early, and feel safe.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: This flight is oversold. We need volunteers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody moves. Then the gate agent calls your name.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You did nothing wrong. The airline sold your seat twice, on purpose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A seat is like fresh milk. After takeoff, it can never be sold.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And every day, some passengers just don't show up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Airlines track exactly how many, route by route.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Estimates put no-shows between five and fifteen percent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So on a hundred and sixty seat jet, the computer might sell sixteen extra tickets.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Most days, the sleepers cancel out the extras and every seat is full.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some days, everyone shows up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the airline buys seats back, with vouchers, from volunteers first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If nobody bites, someone gets bumped, and the airline can owe up to four times the fare.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's rare. In twenty sixteen, about nine in ten thousand passengers lost their seat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tonight, it happened to you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You take the voucher. Seat fourteen C flies without you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the guy who hit snooze? He just booked tomorrow's flight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Guess which seat he got.
